import re,os,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
print(sorted(G))

def segs(sz, seps):
    out=[]; s=0
    for e in seps+[sz]:
        if e>s: out.append((s,e))
        s=e+1
    return out

def analyze(grid, out):
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    sep=cnt.most_common(3)[2][0]  # 3rd? risky; find full lines
    rb=[i for i in range(H) if len(set(grid[i]))==1]
    cb=[j for j in range(W) if len(set(grid[i][j] for i in range(H)))==1]
    sep=grid[rb[0]][0]
    c=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x!=sep)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]; mk=[k for k in c if k!=bg][0]
    rs,cs=segs(H,rb),segs(W,cb)
    print('sep',sep,'bg',bg,'mk',mk,'rowblocks',len(rs),'colblocks',len(cs),'out',len(out),'x',len(out[0]))
    info=[]
    for ri,(r0,r1) in enumerate(rs):
        row=[]
        for ci,(c0,c1) in enumerate(cs):
            n=sum(1 for i in range(r0,r1) for j in range(c0,c1) if grid[i][j]==mk)
            area=(r1-r0)*(c1-c0)
            row.append((n,area,out[ri][ci]))
        info.append(row)
    return info, mk

i1,o1=analyze(G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output'])
print(json.dumps(i1))
i2,o2=analyze(G['Demo pair 2 input'],G['Demo pair 2 output'])
print(json.dumps(i2))
t_info,_=analyze(G['Test input'],[[0]*4]*3)
print(json.dumps(t_info))
